title: Commercial-Viability UI Foundation
goal: Tighten first-run operator clarity and cross-platform UI reliability through font-stack hardening, explicit onboarding and empty states, and a non-empty Surface Map fallback.
scope: Implement the first commercial-viability UI slice after the current conversational-intake task by replacing Windows-only primary font stacks with a local-safe cross-platform stack, adding truthful first-run guidance and empty states, and rendering host-card Surface Map content from existing inventory data before any heavier graph work.
generation_reason: Anti-drift hardening for the repo-backed post-intake backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not promote or implement this task until the current task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed and logged.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Stay inside the defined UI polish slice and defer heavier navigation consolidation, D3 graph work, remediation UX, and live telemetry to later queue items.
notes: Use a local-safe stack headed by Inter or system-ui and do not add a new runtime fetch to Google Fonts in this slice.
Reuse existing inventory aggregation for Surface Map host cards instead of adding a new graph library.

success_criteria: Primary UI and report-preview placeholder font stacks no longer rely on Aptos, Bahnschrift, or other Windows-only primaries.
The first-run no-engagement state gives a direct operator-start instruction instead of a blank or context-free intake screen.
Major empty panels show action-oriented empty-state copy instead of blank containers.
Surface Map renders host-card content from existing run inventory when assets exist, without waiting for a graph implementation.
Browser validation covers no-engagement, no-inventory, and populated-inventory states.

acceptance_criteria: A Kali/Linux operator sees the intended cross-platform font fallback instead of a generic Windows-only degradation.
An untouched first-run or no-data panel always tells the operator what appears there and what action unlocks it.
Surface Map shows usable host cards when discovery-confirmed inventory is present and a truthful empty state when it is not.

before_promotion: The active conversational-intake task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed, logged, and removed from active status.
python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py passes with this package still queued.
TASK_QUEUE.md order remains unchanged unless the queue is explicitly edited and logged.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the concrete UI slice and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the shipped UI behavior and any remaining limitations.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md and rerun python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py.

out_of_scope: Evidence Replay or Explorer screen consolidation
